# stalwart_ai_model_type_safe (Resource)

Defines an AI model endpoint used by AI-assisted features such as the spam classifier and the Sieve llm_prompt function. Manages the TypeSafe variant. Requires an Enterprise license.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Short name used to reference this model

### Optional

- `allow_invalid_certs` (Boolean) Whether to accept invalid TLS certificates from the endpoint
- `api_key` (Attributes) API key sent to the provider using its native authentication header (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_key))
- `http_headers` (Map of String) Additional headers to include in requests to the provider
- `max_concurrent_requests` (Number) Maximum number of requests sent to this model at the same time
- `model` (String) Model identifier sent to the provider
- `rate_limit` (Attributes) Maximum number of requests sent to this model within the rate period, spaced evenly. When empty, no rate limit is applied. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rate_limit))
- `timeout` (Number) Maximum time to wait for a single response from the endpoint
- `url` (String) Base URL of the provider API. When empty, the provider's default URL is used.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--api_key"></a>
### Nested Schema for `api_key`

Required:

- `type` (String) Variant discriminator.

Optional:

- `file_path` (String) File path to read the secret from
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Password or secret value
- `variable_name` (String) Environment variable name to read the secret from


<a id="nestedatt--rate_limit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rate_limit`

Optional:

- `count` (Number) Count
- `period` (Number) Period
